3.heading: As the dew of Hermon:
refs: Mr. Maundrell says, "We were sufficiently instructed by experience what the holy Psalmist means by the dew of Hermon,' our tents being as wet with it as if it had rained all night." Some suppose that Zion here means a part of Mount Hermon - Deut 4:48 but it is not written Sion here, but Zion, which is at Jerusalem. Deut 3:8-9
